name: Veerjyoti Puraskars
benefit: - A cash prize of ₹20,000/- is provided to each selected awardee. - A scroll/citation is provided to each selected awardee. - The award is conferred on Republic Day, which is the 26th of January, every year. - The award is restricted to only two persons annually.
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be a woman or girl. - The applicant must have shown exceptional bravery and courage. - The applicant must have acted against any type of atrocities, violence, and/or harassment against themselves or against any other woman or girl. - The actions must have taken place at home, in the workplace, or anywhere in the public domain. - The applicant must have fought for their respect and dignity in society.
